name: FlexGS
definition: An elastic inference method for 3DGS that trains once and adapts to varying computational constraints at inference time by selecting and transforming a subset of Gaussians based on a desired model size ratio, without requiring additional fine-tuning.
summary: FlexGS is an elastic 3D Gaussian Splatting method that dynamically selects and transforms a Gaussian subset at inference time to adapt to computational constraints without fine-tuning.
